desc: The Tosahwi from Half Face Blades is a beast of a fixed blade knife named after the Penateka Comanche chief. It thrives in fighting daily tasks or combat situations. Use the jimped thumb ramp for precise cuts and superior control. Enjoy the comfortably contoured handle with finger grooves and texturing to boot. And when you're done using it, tuck it away in its suede-lined adjustable Kydex sheath.
